mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 54 degrees with overcast skies at Fireman's Park. There is a waxing crescent moon, and the ISS will pass overhead tonight, though you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 47 degrees with no rain predicted.

The big story is the arrest of a school bus driver on Thursday for O W I. Additionally, the City of Verona has updated its zoning and sign ordinances, and residents are reminded to double-check their polling locations, as two new locations were added in 2023.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, or Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look out for live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, and on October 17th, we have the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Paddy Mac's.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired after receiving reports of dangerous driving. Alcohol was ruled out as a factor, and fortunately, no injuries were reported.
We have wrapped up our serving of Crazy for Cookie Dough for the day. We are currently closed, but we look forward to serving tomorrow's flavor, OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, starting at 10:00 AM.
